author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅಸಹನೆ ಕೋಪಗಳು ಮಾನವನ ಧೃತಿಗೆಡಿಸೆ
ಅಸಮರ್ಥನಾಗುವನು ಕರ್ಮ ಮಾಡುದಕೆ
ಹಸನದುವೆ ಜೀವನವು ಸಹನೆ ಸಂಯಮವಿರಲು
ಕಸುವದುವೆ ನಿನಗೆಂದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When impatience and anger shake a person’s nerve,
he becomes unable to do his work;
life becomes fine when there is patience and restraint;
that is your strength forever, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Impatience and anger disable us. Patience and self-control make life good and are a lasting strength.
